onset.Description: Intended onset of the scene image, relative to the start of the run.

duration.Description: Intended on-screen duration of the scene image (search interval; duplicate of stim_dur).

trial_type.Description: Validity of the memory-based prediction that this trial's scene provides for the upcoming (next) trial (duplicate of cue_validity).

Levels.valid: Distortion will appear at the predicted target location
Levels.invalid: Distortion will appear at the competitor location (the pairmate's target location)
Levels.nopred: Distortion location is unpredictable (trial-unique novel scene)

stim_file.Description: Path to the presented warped scene image, relative to /stimuli/.

cue_cond.Description: Whether the presented scene was one of the 24 critical (previously learned) scenes, or a trial-unique novel scene never associated with a location.

Levels.old: One of the 24 critical scenes previously learned
Levels.new: Trial-unique novel scene with no associated location

next_comp_ang.Description: Polar angle (degrees) of the competitor location associated with the scene that will be shown on the next trial (i.e., the target location of that scene's pairmate).

next_comp_x.Description: Cartesian x-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_comp_ang.

next_comp_y.Description: Cartesian y-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_comp_ang.

next_targ_comp_dist.Description: Angular distance (degrees) between the target and competitor locations for the scene that will be shown on the next trial.

next_target_ang.Description: Polar angle (degrees) of the target location associated with the scene that will be shown on the next trial (i.e., the memory-based prediction available during this trial's inter-trial interval).

next_target_x.Description: Cartesian x-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_target_ang.

next_target_y.Description: Cartesian y-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_target_ang.

stim_category.Description: Scene category label. Only populated for the 24 critical scenes; empty for novel scenes.

stim_exemplar.Description: Exemplar number (1 or 2) distinguishing pairmates within a scene category.

stim_name.Description: Base stimulus identifier for the presented scene, without warp/location suffix.

target_eccen.Description: Eccentricity (degrees of visual angle) of the studied target/competitor locations; fixed at 3.3.

target_validity.Description: Validity of this trial's distortion location relative to the prediction carried over from the preceding trial's scene cue. Uses the same valid/invalid/nopred labels as trial_type/cue_validity, but is not the same value: target_validity on trial n equals cue_validity on trial n-1, not trial n.

Levels.valid: Distortion appeared at the predicted target location
Levels.invalid: Distortion appeared at the competitor location

target_ang.Description: Polar angle (degrees) of this trial's distortion (target) location.

target_x.Description: Cartesian x-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to target_ang.

target_y.Description: Cartesian y-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to target_ang.

comp_ang.Description: Polar angle (degrees) of this trial's competitor location (the target location of this scene's pairmate).

comp_x.Description: Cartesian x-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to comp_ang.

comp_y.Description: Cartesian y-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to comp_ang.

targ_comp_dist.Description: Angular distance (degrees) between this trial's target and competitor locations.

cue_validity.Description: Validity of the memory-based prediction that this trial's scene provides for the upcoming (next) trial.

Levels.valid: The next trial's distortion will appear at this scene's target location
Levels.invalid: The next trial's distortion will appear at this scene's competitor location
Levels.nopred: This scene provides no usable prediction for the next trial (trial-unique novel scene)

warp_ang.Description: Polar angle (degrees) of the location used to center the gaze-contingent cortical-magnification warp applied to the image.

warp_x.Description: Cartesian x-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to warp_ang.

warp_y.Description: Cartesian y-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to warp_ang.

warp_strength.Description: Strength parameter of the warp applied to the image.

img_name.Description: Relative path to the presented image file as originally recorded in the source data (duplicate of stim_file).

run.Description: Run number, as recorded in the source data file.

stim_dur.Description: Intended scene presentation duration (duplicate of duration).

iti.Description: Intertrial interval duration following the search period.

stim_onset.Description: Measured (actual, not intended) onset of scene presentation. Recorded for QA purposes to confirm presentation timing.

stim_offset.Description: Measured (actual) offset of scene presentation. Recorded for QA purposes only.

resp_x.Description: Horizontal gaze position (degrees of visual angle) of the scored saccade response. Used for participant feedback not analyses.

resp_y.Description: Vertical gaze position (degrees of visual angle) of the scored saccade response. Used for participant feedback not analyses.

targ_err.Description: Angular error (degrees) between the saccade endpoint and the target location. Used for participant feedback not analyses.

comp_err.Description: Angular error (degrees) between the saccade endpoint and the competitor location. Used for participant feedback not analyses.

warp_err.Description: Angular error (degrees) between the saccade endpoint and the center of the warp location. Used for participant feedback not analyses.

ang_acc.Description: Whether the saccade endpoint fell near the warp location, per an angular-error threshold criterion (boolean). Used for participant feedback not analyses.

warp_fix.Description: Whether the participant's gaze dwelled within a fixed radius of the warp location for at least a minimum cumulative duration during the response window (boolean). Used for participant feedback not analyses.

acc.Description: Whether the search was successful. Used for participant feedback not analyses. Identical to ang_acc for subj14 onward; for other subjects an earlier version of the scoring code could yield a different acc value on ~1.5-6% of trials.
